subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should maintainers accept `device-enterprise`, `COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN`, `models.providers.github-copilot.params.githubDomain`, domain-scoped Copilot token caching, and one SDK host-normalizer export as the supported bundled-provider fix for GHE.com data-residency Copilot users?
rationale: The code and live proof support the fix, but it changes auth routing, persisted provider params, an environment override, SDK surface, and token-host boundaries that need explicit owner/security acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed design, dismiss stale fixed reviews, refresh the merge, and land once required checks remain green.

options.title: Narrow the public surface further
options.body: Ask the branch to remove or internalize more of the auth/config/SDK surface if maintainers want data-residency routing but not this exposed shape.

options.title: Pause or reject bundled tenant routing
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide GHE.com Copilot data-residency support should not live inside the bundled provider.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Keep the current fail-closed design, dismiss stale fixed reviews, refresh the merge, and land once required checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion cites this handle's owner guidance for the existing-provider direction, and git history links this handle to recent relevant provider/docs work and merges.
